guideline: Compose ui from small function components
do: Derive state from props and keep components pure

guideline: Stabilize callbacks passed to memoized children
do: Wrap handlers in useCallback when identity matters
dont: Create a new function literal on every render

guideline: Keep side effects in useEffect with cleanup
Views are value types rebuilt from state
dont: Hold view logic in class singletons

guideline: Use layout containers not absolute frames
dont: Hard-code x y positions for adaptive ui

guideline: Control rebuild scope with const and keys
dont: Rebuild the whole page on a text change

guideline: Ui is a function of state via composables
do: Hoist state to the lowest common owner
dont: Mutate shared mutable state in composition

guideline: Bind ui to x:Bind or INotifyPropertyChanged
dont: Set control values from code-behind timers

guideline: Follow Fluent density and icon sizing
do: Use theme resources for colors and brushes
dont: Hard-code hex colors that break dark mode

guideline: Use MVVM with commands over event handlers
dont: Write click handlers that touch the database

guideline: Target styles and selectors not code-behind
Keep scene graph updates on the fx thread
Use design tokens as config not ad-hoc values
do: Extend theme with semantic color names
dont: Sprinkle raw hex values through class lists

guideline: Keep components single-responsibility with script setup
do: Emit events upward mutate state at the source
dont: Emit events upward and mutate props

do: Merge static meshes and cap pixel ratio
dont: Create a new material per frame
